name: r2_in_1
prompt: This is the full UI of a photoreal pedal steel guitar audio plugin. Keep proportions and everything the same: output ONE image, landscape 1536x1024, identical to the input in framing, layout, scale, lighting, colours and every detail. Also light the A, B and C lamps warm amber and press A, B and C down slightly into the panel (no glow on the panel). Show the LKL and LKR knee levers ENGAGED by swinging each one INWARD, toward the centre between them (LKL's paddle moves right, LKR's paddle moves left), a short travel of about 20 degrees on its pivot ring. The spacing must stay balanced: each lever's paddle stays centred under its LKL / LKR label, the pair stays evenly spaced and centred in its section, well clear of the divider line and the panel edge. Nothing else changes.
